title: When the Group Chat Wakes
author: Gideon Coldharbour
blurb: Quentin Dunmore, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
